Container.Name: indigo-stats
Container.Overview: Private PurpleAir dashboard with minute-level local collection, historical charts, weather and air-quality comparisons, and an installable PWA. Python and SQLite run in one container. Set your sensor's LAN IPv4 address and map /data to persistent local appdata storage. Forecasts are optional and send configured coordinates to Open-Meteo only when enabled. No login is included: use a trusted LAN or private reverse proxy/Tailscale for access; never expose this app directly to the internet. HTTPS is needed for mobile PWA installation. No host services, routes, or Tailscale settings are changed by this container.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Trusted-LAN HTTP port. Use a private HTTPS reverse proxy for mobile PWA installation. No authentication is included.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and local backups. Use local SSD-backed appdata; do not use SMB/NFS. Keep this directory when replacing the container.

Config.Name: PurpleAir sensor IP
Config.Description: Your PurpleAir device's private LAN IPv4 address. Reserve its DHCP address. No automatic subnet scanning occurs.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone for charts, such as America/Los_Angeles or Europe/London.

Config.Name: Sensor placement
Config.Description: Physical installation location. Choose the PM correction separately.

Config.Name: PM2.5 method
Config.Description: cf1 preserves raw channel-average PM2.5. epa2021 applies the US outdoor correction with raw humidity; it is not the extended wildfire formula.

Config.Name: Temperature and humidity
Config.Description: purpleair matches PurpleAir estimated ambient layers. raw shows operating sensor readings. simple applies -8 F and +4 humidity points. Raw values are always retained.

Config.Name: Enable regional forecasts
Config.Description: Enable only after supplying latitude and longitude. Coordinates are sent to Open-Meteo for weather and regional air-quality forecasts; your street address is not sent.

Config.Name: Forecast latitude
Config.Description: Optional private latitude (-90 to 90). Enter both coordinates or leave both blank. Never publish a filled-in template.

Config.Name: Forecast longitude
Config.Description: Optional private longitude (-180 to 180). Coordinates remain out of browser responses.

Config.Name: Private location label/address
Config.Description: Optional local-only address or label. Not geocoded, sent to providers, or returned to the browser.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root UID for application files. Unraid nobody is normally 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID for application files. Unraid users is normally 100.
